evals.prompt: I get 45 minutes of deep work a day. How do I get more?
evals.expected_output: Audits the week, picks a depth scheduling philosophy, designs a ritual, blocks the calendar, and manages attention residue.
assertions: Designs a ritual with location, duration, and rules
Blocks the calendar for deep work
Addresses attention residue when switching tasks

evals.prompt: Should I check email before my deep work block?
evals.expected_output: Advises against it. Checking email creates attention residue that degrades focus for 15 to 20 minutes.
assertions: Advises against checking email before deep work
Recommends a transition buffer between shallow and deep work

evals.prompt: How many deep hours should I aim for each week?
evals.expected_output: Targets 15 to 20+ deep hours per week and trains focus gradually, extending sessions by 10 to 15 minutes per week.
assertions: Targets 15 to 20+ deep hours per week
